title: Kiln native review registry v1 (host-owned, not player acknowledgements)
$comment: The Rust reader also rejects duplicate keys, validates actual calendar dates, requires an applicable absentPath for probe/export classes, and imposes a 1 MiB/depth-64 bound. Ordinary/delay banned imports are never overridden. A guarded dynamic-export exception requires supported absent behavior. Presence feature-disabled is partial and needs a launcher warning. Runtime checks/loader notifications remain required for every admitted DLL. No corpus review records ship here.
